notes: §2002:13.16.58.3 GR11: in an output-CD record (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9), each of the eight BINARY-CHAR/SHORT/LONG/DOUBLE SIGNED/UNSIGNED items holds both ends of each minimum range (signed lower end -2**(w-1)+1, the 2002 table's strict <; unsigned 0 and 2**w-1), and the signed BINARY-CHAR values -127 and 127 survive the moves to SHORT, LONG and DOUBLE. The case matched at --std 2002.
